important: The RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) features require the vector store to be populated.
Run 'python scripts/ingest_csv_data.py' if you get 'Knowledge index not ready' errors.
Some endpoints may return empty results if the FAISS vector indexes don't exist yet.
The Groq API key in .env is used for generating answers via LLM.
PostgreSQL database should be running for ticket-related endpoints to work.
